protocol: Eight whole-order folds. Three gradient boosting models share one specification and receive registration plus observed budget and missing indicators, then active service identities, then full charges. For held paying passengers, up to 32 distinct training orders within 1.5x observed total and identical missing-field pattern donate a service basket. Ranking uses distance in budget, origin, deck, destination. Integer apportionment preserves the query bill and the donor active services. The face control also holds all five service presence indicators constant. A seeded matched donor is the sham contrast. All training omits names, outcomes of query orders, and archive decisions.
